name: DWH Projector Projection Profile
purpose: provide one effective declarative projector projection and its explicit renderer binding
requestIdentity: the suffix after #PROJECTOR: is the canonical WebEngine projector id without case rewriting

data.renderer: canonical logical root-relative executable renderer module binding
data.projection: effective declarative projector data after DWH-owned relation/variant resolution

rules: WebEngine must not derive projector declarations from /app/<domain>/projectors files
WebEngine must not derive renderer binding from projector naming convention
renderer binding must be explicit in the DWH projection
DWH resolves variant inheritance/deltas before returning the effective projection
missing projector or renderer binding fails visibly with no WebEngine fallback
